finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back.** One root cause, not many.

`connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` at [app.log:182](logs/app.log#L182). Cache fell back to direct store reads. That store then buckled: 106 `TimeoutError` at 5000ms. All 7 reconnect tries failed, last at 02:23:26. Queue depth climbed 52 to 367 of 500 and was still rising when the log ends at 02:24:44. Traffic was clean before 02:14.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12` refused connections. Nothing here says it restarted.
